▶️ 直接在云端运行：

💡概述

ComfyUI格子2将输入图像转换为基于体素的结构化 3D 网格，具有很强的几何一致性。 Trellis2 不是生成平面图像，而是生成可编辑的 3D 几何图形，保留源图像的视觉结构。

它专为 3D 艺术家、技术艺术家和设计师而设计，提供简单和高级的图像到网格管道，可完全控制网格分辨率、体素密度和生成行为。

✨ 主要特点

  • 图像到 3D 管道：一次性将照片或概念艺术转换为结构化 3D 网格。

  • 网格细化：用于重新网格化、简化和拓扑优化的专用阶段。

  • 紫外线和纹理：通过 UV 展开和光栅化纹理生成进行完整的后处理，以实现生产就绪的输出。

  • GLB 出口：干净的导出可用于实时预览、游戏引擎或外部 3D 工具。

  • 多视图支持：接受多视图图像输入以提高几何精度。

🚀 开始使用

  1. 上传您的源图片— 照片、概念艺术或渲染对象。

  2. 选择您的管道— 简单（快速）或高级（完全控制分辨率和体素密度）。

  3. 生成— 该工作流程生成带纹理的 3D 网格并导出 GLB 文件。

单击上面的“直接运行”链接绕过本地设置并立即在浏览器中测试此工作流程。

🚀 Convert any image into structured, editable 3D meshes with precise geometry, topology control, texturing, and GLB export.

▶️ Run Directly in Cloud:
https://www.runcomfy.com/comfyui-workflows/comfyui-trellis2-workflow-advanced-structure-image-generation?utm_source=civitai

💡 Overview

ComfyUI Trellis2transforms input images into structured voxel-based 3D meshes with strong geometric consistency. Instead of generating flat images, Trellis2 produces editable 3D geometry that preserves the visual structure of the source image.

Designed for 3D artists, technical artists, and designers — it provides both simple and advanced image-to-mesh pipelines with full control over mesh resolution, voxel density, and generation behavior.

✨ Key Features

  • Image-to-3D Pipeline:Convert photos or concept art into structured 3D meshes in one pass.

  • Mesh Refinement:Dedicated stages for remeshing, simplification, and topology optimization.

  • UV & Texturing:Full post-processing with UV unwrapping and rasterized texture generation for production-ready outputs.

  • GLB Export:Clean exports ready for real-time previews, game engines, or external 3D tools.

  • Multi-View Support:Accepts multi-view image inputs for enhanced geometric accuracy.

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Upload your source image— a photo, concept art, or rendered object.

  2. Choose your pipeline— simple (fast) or advanced (full control over resolution and voxel density).

  3. Generate— the workflow produces a textured 3D mesh and exports a GLB file.

Click the "Run Directly" link above to bypass local setup and test this workflow immediately in your browser.
